name: STEALING BUNDLES
description: Stealing Bundles (also known as Stealing the Old Man's Bundle) is a simple fishing card game for two or more players, popular with children. It is similar to Casino but simplified. Players capture face-up cards from the table by matching their rank. Captured cards are stacked in a 'bundle'. The unique twist is that players can steal an opponent's entire bundle by matching the top card.

A children's fishing game also known as Steal the Old Man's Bundle or Steal Pile. A very similar game is played in Argentina as Casita Robada and in Italy as Rubamazzo. It is classified as a fishing game and shares capture-by-rank and bundle-building with games like Casino but is simplified for young players.
2, 3 or 4 players. First dealer is chosen by everyone drawing a card; highest card deals (tied players draw again).
Standard 52-card pack; suits are ignored for matching (only rank matters).
Standard 52-card pack; suits are ignored for matching (only rank matters).
Dealer gives each player 5 cards; remaining cards are dealt face-up to the table. Play starts to the left of the dealer.

items.text: Standard: Five cards each; remainder to table; capture by rank, steal bundle by matching top, or trail.
Hand size variant: Some house rules use a different number of cards per player (e.g. 4 or 6).
